{{Top|leg}}
'''Parthenogenesis''' was a form of natural reproduction which was similar to [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] in many respects. It needed only one parent of the [[Gender/Legends|female]] sex who would give birth when conditions and environment where best suited to raising the child. The [[M'shinn]] [[Species/Legends|species]] reproduced through parthenogenesis, giving birth to tiny [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeter]] long babies which would live in their belly pouches for one hundred [[Standard day/Legends|days]] before emerging. In optimal conditions M'shinn could give birth to a daughter every three [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="GG12">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Parthenogenesis was first mentioned in [[1995]] in ''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]'', one of the ''[[Galaxy Guide]]'' series of sourcebooks written by [[Lisa Smedman]] and published by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.
